<SCRATCHPAD_REASONING>
Alison has confirmed a time that works for all four partners: Thursday, November 19 at 14:30. My final task is to send the confirmation email to all four partners. I will use the `send_confirmation_email` function to do this. I should make sure the email body is professional and contains all the necessary information, including the date, time, and that it's a 30-minute meeting. After sending the email, my part of the task is complete.I've received the confirmation from Alison. The meeting is scheduled for Thursday, November 19 at 14:30. My remaining task is to send the confirmation email to all four partners. I will draft a clear and concise email with all the necessary details. After sending the email, the task will be complete from my end.
